fullContentHtml:
UPPSC Assistant Professor Mains Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the Mains Admit Card for the recruitment of Assistant Professor posts on its official website. This recruitment was released for 1236 posts. Applications for the UPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 04 September 2025, to 06 October 2025. The Mains examination will be conducted from 15 September to 01 October 2026. Candidates who had appeared in Pre Examination can download their UPPSC Assistant Professor Mains Admit Card 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 September 2025
  • Last Date : 06 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 October 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 10 October 2025
  • Pre Exam Date : 31 May 2026
  • Pre Admit Card Available : 21 May 2026
  • Pre Answer Key : 03 June 2026
  • Pre Result : 07 August 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 15 September to 01 October 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 125/-
  • SC, ST Candidates : Rs. 65/-
  • Ex-Service Candidates : Rs. 65/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs.25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
